cs.t: I use a Das Keyboard at home.  It has a USB cord, you plug it in and it "just works".  Be aware: a good number of their other keyboards come with programmable LED lights that by necessity need special drivers, but the 4 Pro has been great for me.  https://www.daskeyboard.com/daskeyboard-4-professional/  For one of my mice I have a Corsair RGP0075.  It's got a USB RF dongle and Bluetooth that's also plug and play.  however, if you want to disable the led lights on the mouse you need to install their software.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your favorite software-free keyboard and mouse?
